expectations.text: Cuts the nine screenshots to only screens that are hard to find, each with alt text stating what it shows, and notes they must be re-captured when the UI changes.
expectations.evidence: The change table removes the nine GitHub install screenshots as stale third-party UI and replaces them with one step that links GitHub's docs. The hand-over says: 'If you need one, take one only of the Sablefield screen the reader must find. Give it alt text and re-capture it when the UI changes.' That covers keeping only the hard-to-find screen, adding alt text and re-capturing. It does not say the alt text must state what the screenshot shows, and the guidance sits in a hand-over note, not in the page itself.

expectations.evidence: Partly met. The nine screenshots are cut to one, and that image has descriptive alt text: "GitHub repository access screen with 'Only select repositories' chosen". But it was kept because it is "the only place a wrong click has consequences", not because the screen is hard to find. The response notes that GitHub's install screens change and screenshots go stale, but only as a reason for cutting them. It never says the kept screenshot must be re-captured when the UI changes.
